# PDFCompress Pro

> Free online suite of 22+ PDF, image, developer, and calculator tools. 100% private client-side processing directly inside the web browser.

## Core Online Tools

- [PDF Compressor](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/pdf-compressor): Compress PDF files with high reduction and maximum quality.
- [Compress PDF to 200KB](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/compress-pdf-to-200kb): Accurately compress any PDF under 200KB for government and job portals.
- [PDF Merger](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/pdf-merger): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single organized file.
- [PDF Splitter](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/pdf-splitter): Extract and split PDF pages quickly.
- [PDF to JPG](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to high-resolution JPG images.
- [JPG to PDF](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/jpg-to-pdf): Convert images to PDF documents.
- [Image Compressor](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/image-compressor): Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP images.
- [Image Resizer](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/image-resizer): Resize images to custom dimensions.
- [Image Cropper](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/image-cropper): Crop images with standard aspect ratios.
- [QR Code Generator](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/qr-code-generator): Create custom QR codes instantly.
- [EMI Calculator](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/emi-calculator): Financial loan EMI and interest calculator.
- [Age Calculator](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/age-calculator): Calculate precise age down to days and hours.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/cgpa-calculator): Academic CGPA to percentage converter.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/percentage-calculator): Quick percentage math utility.
- [Attendance Calculator](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/attendance-calculator): Calculate target attendance percentage.
- [Date Difference](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/date-difference): Measure days between two dates.
- [Word Counter](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/word-counter): Character, word, and reading time counter.
- [Case Converter](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/case-converter): Convert text between uppercase, lowercase, title, and camelCase.
- [JSON Formatter](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/json-formatter): Format and validate JSON data.
- [Base64 Encoder/Decoder](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/base64-tool): Encode and decode base64 strings.
- [URL Encoder/Decoder](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/url-encoder): Encode and decode URL components.
- [Unit Converter](https://pdfcompressorpro.pages.dev/unit-converter): Convert length, mass, and temperature units.
